Update a boss Object After Filling Essential Design Points

update_boss.Rd

Given a boss_result with essential_design_points already constructed, this function will:

  1. Fill in any missing responses (NA) by evaluating the objective.

  2. Recompute the mode and Hessian at the mode.

  3. Re‐fit the GP hyperparameters (length‐scale and signal variance).

  4. Rebuild the surrogate function closure with the updated design.

Usage

update_boss(boss_result)

Arguments

boss_result

A boss object with essential_design_points (list with x_original, y), and containing lower, upper, and objective_function.

Value

The updated boss_result, with fields essential_design_points$y, mode, mode_hessian, gp_params, and surrogate refreshed.
